cards.answer: Akshan is a marksman and assassin who uses attacks, camouflage and terrain swings to fight. Learn him with an AD focus.
cards.counterplay: Watch for approaches along terrain and avoid giving him repeated hits.

cards.answer: Attacks and ability hits stack on a target; the third stack deals bonus damage and can grant Akshan a shield against champions when available. Basic attacks fire an extra shot, generally for reduced damage. Canceling that extra shot grants a brief burst of movement speed.
cards.counterplay: Avoid letting him build repeated hits on you, and account for his shield during trades.

cards.answer: Akshan throws a boomerang that damages enemies going out and returning, extending its range whenever it hits an enemy. It grants sight along its path and briefly reveals enemies hit. Hitting an enemy champion grants Akshan a brief burst of movement speed.
cards.counterplay: Dodge both passes, and remember that enemies in its path can extend its reach.

citations.quote: Akshan throws a boomerang that deals damage going out and coming back, extending its range each time it hits an enemy.
Once the boomerang has passed its original range and has not recently hit an enemy, it homes back to Akshan and deals the same effects to enemies hit.

cards.answer: Enemy champions who kill Akshan's allies become Scoundrels; a qualifying takedown grants bonus gold, revives dead allies slain by that enemy and clears the other Scoundrel marks. Activating W grants camouflage that persists near terrain or in brush and expires quickly elsewhere. While active, he sees trails toward Scoundrels and gains movement speed and mana regeneration when pursuing them under the ability's conditions.
cards.counterplay: Watch terrain and brush for concealed approaches. If marked, avoid giving Akshan a chance to take you down and revive allies.

citations.quote: Akshan passively marks enemy champions as Scoundrels when they kill his ally champions.

If Akshan scores a takedown against a Scoundrel while alive and within 3 seconds of damaging them, he receives an additional 100 and resurrects all dead allied champions that they have slain after 1 second.
When Akshan claims a Scoundrel's bounty he removes the marks of all other enemies.

facts.claim: Enemy champions who kill Akshan's allies become Scoundrels; a qualifying takedown grants bonus gold, revives dead allies slain by that enemy and clears the other Scoundrel marks.

Akshan loses the camouflage quickly while he is not in brush or near terrain.

cards.answer: Akshan hooks terrain and swings around it, automatically firing at eligible enemies. He can jump off early and fire a final shot; colliding with an enemy champion or terrain ends the swing. Enemy champion takedowns refresh the ability with a brief remaining cooldown.
cards.counterplay: Keep away from his swing path or interrupt him with immobilizing crowd control. Expect another swing after a champion takedown.

cards.answer: Akshan locks onto an enemy champion and stores bullets, firing them early or automatically after charging. Each bullet hits the first champion, minion or structure in its path. Damage to champions and structures increases with their missing health; minions are executed.
cards.counterplay: Put intervening minions or structures between you and Akshan to intercept bullets.
